note: Graham Hill Campground, on a hilltop in ponderosa pine and oak near the Santa Cruz Sandhills (separate entrance off Graham Hill Rd, not in the redwoods; trails link it to the redwood grove). Coin-op hot showers. Trailers to 31 ft; back-in pads 19-35 ft, so check the pad length when booking. --Claude
